events.title: Attack UKMTO #181 22 October 2026 UKMTO WARNING 181-26 ATTACK Incident Date: 22 OCT 2026 Incident Time: 1715UTC UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 7NM northeast of Limah, Oman. A tanker has reported being hit by an unknown projectile whilst transiting outbound in the Strait of Hormuz. The tanker was able to continue its voyage to the next port of call.

Attack UKMTO #179 21 October 2026 UKMTO WARNING 179-26 - ATTACK Incident Date:21 Oct 2026 Incident Time:0145UTC Local Authorities UKMTO has received a report of an incident 11NM west of Bukha, Oman. Local Authorities have reported that a Tanker has been struck by an unknown projectile which started a fire which has been extinguished. The Tanker is now at anchor. All crew are reported as safe. There is no reported environmental impact at this time. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #180 20 October 2026 UKMTO WARNING 180-26 - ATTACK Incident Date:20 Oct 2026 Incident Time:1830UTC Source: Master UKMTO has received a time late report of an incident 30NM southeast of Al Faw, Iraq. The Master of a tanker reports being struck by an unknown projectile, the crew are reported as safe and there is no reported damage or environmental impact. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate. Attack UKMTO #177 18 October 2026 UKMTO WARNING 177-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 18 OCT 2026 Incident Time: TBC UKMTO has received a report of an incident northeast of Khor Fakkan, UAE. A tug travelling southbound has reported being struck by 2 unknown projectiles. The tug has sustained damage but is continuing on its route. One minor casualty has been reported. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #176 17 October 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 140NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen. A Master of an LNG Tanker has reported being approached by a small skiff with seven persons onboard. The skiff fired two shots at the tanker whose armed Security Team fired two warning shots at the small skiff which forced them to alter course. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.
